what_it_is.prose:
IIT Kanpur-incubated (SIIC) defence UAV developer led by Prof Subrahmanyam Saderla: long-endurance aerial platforms, launchers and simulators. Strategic partnership with PATH Group (reported by BusinessLine as a takeover, with an Indore factory).

Value-chain position in the Atlas: related to → IIT Kanpur (L2).

Evidence discipline: this record separates company claims from independent evidence. Classifications above carry their evidence level; the technology-origin class is 'UNKNOWN'. Exhibiting at Drone Expo 2026 establishes market presence only — not indigenous technology, Indian manufacturing, procurement or deployment.
